svg.desc: ScadaCraft OpenBridge widget: Radial bar chart (obc-radial-bar-chart, OpenBridge 1.0.0, Apache-2.0). Library: OpenBridge · Charts. Box 240x240 px, anchor at (0,0). Bindable properties: _pn_value1 (default 0, read): Ring 1 value _pn_value2 (default 0, read): Ring 2 value _pn_value3 (default 0, read): Ring 3 value _pn_rings (default 3, read): Rings shown (1-3) _pn_max (default 100, read): Full-scale value of every ring
